description.zh: 把 Win顺 的设置备份自动传到 WebDAV（坚果云、NAS 等）或 GitHub 私有仓库，换电脑时输入 cloud 一键恢复
description.en: Keeps Win顺's settings backup on a WebDAV server or in a private GitHub repository; type cloud to restore it on another PC

description.zh: 立即备份到云端，或从云端的备份恢复设置
description.en: Back up to the cloud now, or restore the settings from a backup there

hint.zh: 备份放进这个文件夹，没有会自动建。坚果云填 https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/WinShun；不用 WebDAV 就留空
hint.en: Backups go into this folder, made when missing, e.g. https://dav.example.com/dav/WinShun; leave empty to not use WebDAV

hint.zh: 坚果云等要填“应用密码”。存在 Windows 凭据管理器里，不进设置文件，也不进备份
hint.en: Some services want an app password. Kept in Windows Credential Manager, not in the settings file or the backups

hint.zh: 写成 用户名/仓库名，或贴仓库网址。必须是私有仓库，公开仓库不会上传；不用 GitHub 就留空
hint.en: owner/name, or the repository's address. It must be private: nothing is uploaded to a public one. Leave empty to not use GitHub

hint.zh: 细粒度令牌只选这一个仓库，给 Contents 读写权限。存在 Windows 凭据管理器里
hint.en: A fine-grained token for this repository only, with Contents: read and write. Kept in Windows Credential Manager

hint.zh: 一般留空；GitHub Enterprise 填 https://你的服务器/api/v3
启动两分钟后检查一次，之后每半小时一次；设置没变就不上传。关掉后只在输入 cloud 按 Enter 时备份
hint.en: Checked two minutes after start and every half hour; nothing is uploaded while the settings are the same. Off: only when you type cloud and press Enter

hint.zh: 超出的旧备份会从云端删掉
hint.en: Older ones are removed from the cloud
